ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, the left side is glass rod S1, and the right side is glass rod S2; the dashed principal axes of the two rods coincide. The convex curved-surface end of S1 faces the air gap on the right, and the convex curved-surface end of S2 faces the air gap on the left; the axial distance between the vertices of the two convex surfaces is marked as d. Point light source P is on the internal axis of S1, and the figure marks its distance to the curved-surface end of S1 as 50 cm; the outgoing light rays inside S2 are parallel along the axial direction. Reasoning: Take light traveling from left to right as the positive direction, and the spherical refraction formula is n2/v - n1/u = (n2 - n1)/R. First look at the right end surface of S1. Light enters air from glass, so n1 = 1.5 and n2 = 1; object point P is 50 cm to the left of this surface, so u = -50 cm. This convex surface bulges to the right, and its center of curvature is inside the glass on the left, so R = -10 cm. Substitute: 1/v - 1.5/(-50) = (1 - 1.5)/(-10), that is, 1/v + 0.03 = 0.05, giving v = 50 cm. Therefore, after passing through the curved surface of S1, the light rays in air seem to converge at a point 50 cm to the right of the curved surface of S1. Next look at the left end surface of S2. Light enters glass from air, so n1 = 1 and n2 = 1.5; its center of curvature is on the right, so R = +10 cm. The problem gives that after entering S2 the light rays are parallel, so after refraction by S2, v = infinity. Substitute into the formula: 1.5/infinity - 1/u = (1.5 - 1)/10, giving -1/u = 0.05, therefore u = -20 cm. That is to say, for S2, the object point of the incident light must be 20 cm to the left of its curved surface. Therefore, the intermediate image point is both 50 cm to the right of the curved surface of S1 and 20 cm to the left of the curved surface of S2, so the distance between the vertices of the two curved surfaces is d = 50 + 20 = 70 cm.

raw_record.question_text: Two identical glass rods $S_1$ and $S_2$ (refractive index = 1.5) have one convex end of radius of curvature 10 cm. They are placed with the curved surfaces at a distance $d$ as shown in the figure, with their axes aligned. When a point source of light $P$ is placed inside rod $S_1$ on its axis at a distance of 50 cm from the curved face, the light rays emanating from it are found to be parallel to the axis inside $S_2$. method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the left rod S1 has its convex curved end facing right into the air gap, the right rod S2 has its convex curved end facing left into the same gap, their dashed axes coincide, P lies on the axis inside S1, and d is the axial separation between the two curved vertices. Use the spherical refracting surface formula with positive direction left-to-right: n2/v - n1/u = (n2-n1)/R. For the S1 surface, light goes glass to air, so n1=1.5, n2=1, u=-50 cm, and because the center of curvature of the right-facing convex end lies inside S1 to the left, R=-10 cm. This gives v=+50 cm: after the first surface the rays would meet at a point 50 cm to the right of the S1 curved face. For the S2 surface, light goes air to glass, the center of curvature lies to the right, so R=+10 cm. Since rays inside S2 are parallel, set v=infinity in the same formula; this requires u=-20 cm, i.e. the object for S2 must be 20 cm to the left of its curved face. Therefore the intermediate image 50 cm right of S1 must be 20 cm left of S2, so d=50+20=70 cm.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中左侧是玻璃棒 S1，右侧是玻璃棒 S2，两棒的虚线主轴重合。S1 的凸曲面端朝向右侧空气间隙，S2 的凸曲面端朝向左侧空气间隙；两凸面顶点间的轴向距离标为 d。点光源 P 在 S1 内部轴线上，图中标出它到 S1 曲面端的距离为 50 cm，S2 内部出射光线沿轴线方向平行。

推理：取光从左到右为正方向，球面折射公式为 n2/v - n1/u = (n2 - n1)/R。先看 S1 的右端面，光从玻璃进入空气，所以 n1 = 1.5，n2 = 1；物点 P 在该面左侧 50 cm，故 u = -50 cm。该凸面向右鼓出，其曲率中心在左侧玻璃内，所以 R = -10 cm。代入：1/v - 1.5/(-50) = (1 - 1.5)/(-10)，即 1/v + 0.03 = 0.05，得 v = 50 cm。因此经过 S1 曲面后，光线在空气中好像会聚于 S1 曲面右侧 50 cm 处。

再看 S2 的左端面，光从空气进入玻璃，所以 n1 = 1，n2 = 1.5；其曲率中心在右侧，故 R = +10 cm。题给进入 S2 后光线平行，所以对 S2 折射后 v = infinity。代入公式：1.5/infinity - 1/u = (1.5 - 1)/10，得 -1/u = 0.05，因此 u = -20 cm。也就是说，对 S2 来说，入射光的物点必须在其曲面左侧 20 cm 处。

因此中间像点既在 S1 曲面右侧 50 cm，又在 S2 曲面左侧 20 cm，所以两曲面顶点间距离 d = 50 + 20 = 70 cm。

method.method_draft: Use a paraxial ray-transfer/vergence calculation instead of explicitly constructing intermediate images. From the figure, take a small ray from P to the first curved face at height y above the common dashed axis; the final condition shown is that after the second curved face the ray is horizontal inside S2. Use reduced angle alpha=n theta and surface power Phi=(n_after-n_before)/R, with refraction rule alpha_after=alpha_before-Phi y. At the first surface, P is 50 cm to the left in glass, so alpha_before=1.5(y/50)=0.03y. The first face has R=-10 cm, so Phi1=(1-1.5)/(-10)=0.05 cm^-1, hence alpha after S1 is 0.03y-0.05y=-0.02y in air. Propagate across the air gap d: the ray height at the second face is y2=y+d(-0.02y)=y(1-0.02d). For the second surface, R=+10 cm and Phi2=(1.5-1)/10=0.05 cm^-1. Parallel output requires alpha_after_second=0, so -0.02y-0.05y(1-0.02d)=0. Solving gives d=70 cm.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中有两根同轴玻璃棒，左侧为 S1，右侧为 S2；两棒相对的端面都是凸面，中间隔着空气间隙，间隙标为 d。虚线表示公共主轴。点光源 P 位于 S1 内部的主轴上，并标出到 S1 凸面的距离为 50 cm。光线从 P 出发，经 S1 的凸面射入空气间隙，再经 S2 的凸面进入 S2；图中进入 S2 后的光线与主轴平行。题设给出玻璃折射率 n=1.5，凸面曲率半径为 10 cm。

推理：按指定的近轴光线传递/折合角方法。取从 P 发出、到达第一个曲面时高度为 y 的近轴光线，取向右为正。使用折合角 alpha=n theta，曲面光焦度 Phi=(n_after-n_before)/R，折射公式 alpha_after=alpha_before-Phi y。

在第一个曲面前，光线在玻璃中，从 P 到曲面的轴向距离为 50 cm，所以 theta≈y/50，因此 alpha_before=1.5(y/50)=0.03y。第一个曲面是 S1 的右端凸面，其曲率中心在左侧，故 R1=-10 cm。于是 Phi1=(1-1.5)/(-10)=0.05 cm^-1。故出 S1 后在空气中的折合角为 alpha1=0.03y-0.05y=-0.02y。空气中 n=1，所以实际角度 theta1=-0.02y。

光线在空气间隙 d 中传播到第二个曲面，高度变为 y2=y+d theta1=y+d(-0.02y)=y(1-0.02d)。第二个曲面为 S2 的左端凸面，曲率中心在右侧，R2=+10 cm，从空气进入玻璃，所以 Phi2=(1.5-1)/10=0.05 cm^-1。

进入 S2 后光线平行于主轴，故第二次折射后的 alpha_after_second=0。第二曲面前在空气中的折合角仍为 -0.02y，因此 0=-0.02y-0.05y(1-0.02d)。约去 y：-0.02-0.05+0.001d=0，所以 0.001d=0.07，d=70 cm。

图像描述：附图中有两根同轴玻璃棒，左侧为 S1，右侧为 S2；两棒相对的端面都是凸面，中间隔着空气间隙，间隙标为 d。虚线表示公共主轴。点光源 P 位于 S1 内部的主轴上，并标出到 S1 凸面的距离为 50 cm。光线从 P 出发，经 S1 的凸面射入空气间隙，再经 S2 的凸面进入 S2；图中进入 S2 后的光线与主轴平行。题设给出玻璃折射率 n=1.5，凸面曲率半径为 10 cm。

推理：按指定的近轴光线传递/折合角方法。取从 P 发出、到达第一个曲面时高度为 y 的近轴光线，取向右为正。使用折合角 alpha=n theta，曲面光焦度 Phi=(n_after-n_before)/R，折射公式 alpha_after=alpha_before-Phi y。

在第一个曲面前，光线在玻璃中，从 P 到曲面的轴向距离为 50 cm，所以 theta≈y/50，因此 alpha_before=1.5(y/50)=0.03y。第一个曲面是 S1 的右端凸面，其曲率中心在左侧，故 R1=-10 cm。于是 Phi1=(1-1.5)/(-10)=0.05 cm^-1。故出 S1 后在空气中的折合角为 alpha1=0.03y-0.05y=-0.02y。空气中 n=1，所以实际角度 theta1=-0.02y。

光线在空气间隙 d 中传播到第二个曲面，高度变为 y2=y+d theta1=y+d(-0.02y)=y(1-0.02d)。第二个曲面为 S2 的左端凸面，曲率中心在右侧，R2=+10 cm，从空气进入玻璃，所以 Phi2=(1.5-1)/10=0.05 cm^-1。

进入 S2 后光线平行于主轴，故第二次折射后的 alpha_after_second=0。第二曲面前在空气中的折合角仍为 -0.02y，因此 0=-0.02y-0.05y(1-0.02d)。约去 y：-0.02-0.05+0.001d=0，所以 0.001d=0.07，d=70 cm。

raw_record.original_question: Two identical glass rods $S_1$ and $S_2$ (refractive index = 1.5) have one convex end of radius of curvature 10 cm. They are placed with the curved surfaces at a distance $d$ as shown in the figure, with their axes aligned. When a point source of light $P$ is placed inside rod $S_1$ on its axis at a distance of 50 cm from the curved face, the light rays emanating from it are found to be parallel to the axis inside $S_2$. What is the distance $d$?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the attached figure, the left side is glass rod S1, and the right side is glass rod S2; the dashed principal axes of the two rods coincide. The convex curved-surface end of S1 faces the air gap on the right, and the convex curved-surface end of S2 faces the air gap on the left; the axial distance between the vertices of the two convex surfaces is marked as d. Point light source P is on the internal axis of S1, and the figure marks its distance to the curved-surface end of S1 as 50 cm; the outgoing light rays inside S2 are parallel along the axial direction.

Reasoning: Take light traveling from left to right as the positive direction, and the spherical refraction formula is n2/v - n1/u = (n2 - n1)/R. First look at the right end surface of S1. Light enters air from glass, so n1 = 1.5 and n2 = 1; object point P is 50 cm to the left of this surface, so u = -50 cm. This convex surface bulges to the right, and its center of curvature is inside the glass on the left, so R = -10 cm. Substitute: 1/v - 1.5/(-50) = (1 - 1.5)/(-10), that is, 1/v + 0.03 = 0.05, giving v = 50 cm. Therefore, after passing through the curved surface of S1, the light rays in air seem to converge at a point 50 cm to the right of the curved surface of S1.

Next look at the left end surface of S2. Light enters glass from air, so n1 = 1 and n2 = 1.5; its center of curvature is on the right, so R = +10 cm. The problem gives that after entering S2 the light rays are parallel, so after refraction by S2, v = infinity. Substitute into the formula: 1.5/infinity - 1/u = (1.5 - 1)/10, giving -1/u = 0.05, therefore u = -20 cm. That is to say, for S2, the object point of the incident light must be 20 cm to the left of its curved surface.

Therefore, the intermediate image point is both 50 cm to the right of the curved surface of S1 and 20 cm to the left of the curved surface of S2, so the distance between the vertices of the two curved surfaces is d = 50 + 20 = 70 cm.
